Ensembl: Plants release 63 / June 2026 archive; BioMart dataset metadata date 2026-05-14
ontology_version_note: Downloaded master snapshot; content SHA256 is the primary pin; latest file-changing commit is recorded separately.
annotation_qualifier_limitation: BioMart exposes GO evidence but not NOT qualifiers or annotation dates. The transferred layer is not claimed to be a fully qualifier-audited contemporary TAIR GAF.
one_to_many: Union high-confidence Arabidopsis assignments per uniquely bridged carrot gene; count carrot gene once per term
excluded: Ambiguous NCBI/Ensembl bridge, confidence!=1, obsolete/unknown GO; three GO roots
term_bounds: 5 to 5000 background genes fixed before enrichment
multiplicity: global BH over all 11065 set-term tests; one-sided hypergeometric
KEGG: Not performed: no independently validated mapping layer; not needed to complete this gate
